stem.en: Which sentence about copying is the most accurate?

text.en: It stores all its training pictures and joins up pieces of them
It never copies, as no trace of the pile is left in its settings
It keeps no folder, yet a very common image can be nearly copied
It copies only when a user types the name of a living artist

explanation.en: Training leaves settings, not a folder of pictures, so most results are not pulled from a store. But a picture seen a huge number of times can be learned so well that a close copy comes out, even with no artist named.
